title: NAT10 regulates p53 activation through acetylating p53 at K120 and ubiquitinating Mdm2

grounded.evidence_quote: NAT10 acetylates p53 at K120 and stabilizes p53 by counteracting Mdm2 action.
In addition, NAT10 promotes Mdm2 degradation with its intrinsic E3 ligase activity.
Mdm2 is a ubiquitin ligase which functions as an essential inhibitor of p53 6, 7, 8.
